question.text: GAAR (General Anti-Avoidance Rules) CAN be invoked when a Cat III AIF:

answer.text: Is based in a tax-efficient jurisdiction (alone)
Has tax avoidance NOT addressed by LoB Clause in DTAA

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 9.5, GAAR shall NOT be invoked merely because entity is in tax-efficient jurisdiction OR if tax avoidance is addressed by LoB Clause. It CAN be invoked when tax avoidance is NOT sufficiently addressed. **The Trap:** Location alone or genuine substance don't trigger GAAR. **Cross-Exam Context:** CBDT Circular January 27, 2017. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Get DTAA + LoB confirmation when structuring offshore layers.
